reply:
Only one verse in this passage states a kinship relation. [BndP 2,72.79] says "virocanastu prāhlādiḥ", meaning Virocana is the son of Prahlāda (prāhlādi is a patronymic). [BndP 2,72.103] calls the asuras "diteḥ sutān", meaning sons of Diti, but no individual is named there, so I give no statement for it. Hiraṇyakaśipu and Hiraṇyākṣa, Bali and Prahlāda are not linked by any kinship word in these verses.
